Abbott seeks a Global Strategy and Insights Director for its Cardiac Rhythm Management Global Marketing team. This integral leader will be responsible for establishing and leading a global strategy and insights function and play a critical role in shaping strategic direction, identifying growth opportunities, and driving short-term and long-term goals for a billion-dollar, global business.

This Director will bring clarity to our global markets, our market share in different countries and regions, and help track our competition's development. As part of the executive leadership team, this Director will help develop our strategy for short and long-term growth, while being involved in organic and inorganic market growth options.
